scoringSpec.policy: new descriptors fixed before re-run; chosen on scientific merit, not to favor any candidate
scoringSpec.formula: finalHGCPS = product(max(factor, 0.001) ^ routeWeight); route weights sum to 1
scoringSpec.dataRevision: V3.9.8 replaces ten placeholder metal-price inputs; weights and descriptor definitions are unchanged.

priceTable.priceBasis: Manually curated June 2026 metal-equivalent screening inputs; mixed-confidence values, not supplier quotations
priceTable.boundary: The ten named V3.9.8 metals use supplied June 2026 screening values. Confidence is row-specific; formal publication still requires Fastmarkets/USGS/SMM source and price-date verification. Other metals remain explicit fallback placeholders.

recommendation.hostSelectionExplanation: MIL-type host has the highest host-only structural score, while Cu-MOF leads the route-level HGCPS decision after guest, evidence, and risk factors are included.
recommendation.algorithmBasis: pathway-step descriptor screening + preregistered weighted-geometric host-guest scoring
recommendation.confidence: derived from evidence coverage and provenance (medium-high)
recommendation.mainUncertainty: Route-specific same-condition evidence, local coordination, and hydrothermal retention remain uncertain.
recommendation.note: high-priority experimental route, not final proof of catalytic performance

impactSummary.summaryZh: 计入经济性后，低于当前价格中位数的金属主体平均下移 0.2 位，Zr-MOF 的经济性层间变化为 下降 9 位；加入可合成性后，Ti-MOF 下降 1 位。
impactSummary.summaryEn: After economics is included, host metals below the current price median move down by 0.2 ranks on average, while Zr-MOF moves down by 9 ranks; after synthesizability is added, Ti-MOF moves down by 1 ranks.
